title: Initialize Agentic Ops overlay
description: Create the .agentic-ops/ operational overlay only when the user accepts the root-level overlay.
objective: Make the workspace consumable by Agentic Ops CLI/MCP without overwriting AGENTS.md or project docs.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest records overlay mode and active preset.
Git status shows only expected Agentic Ops overlay files.

risks: The repository guide currently says nothing else should live in the root; user approval may be needed before creating .agentic-ops/.
